title: The 1989 Game Boy’s 8‑Bit CPU

scenes.text: 1989 Game Boy used a Sharp LR35902 8‑bit CPU – why it lasted decades

scenes.label: LOW POWER CONSUMPTION
scenes.text: The CPU drew under 1 mA, letting the device run 15+ hours on four AA cells.
scenes.query: Game Boy battery life 15 hours AA cells power consumption
scenes.query2: Game Boy low power usage specs

scenes.label: SIMPLE INSTRUCTION SET
scenes.text: Its 8‑bit instruction set made games small enough to fit on 256‑KB cartridges.
scenes.query: Game Boy 256KB cartridge size instruction set

scenes.label: UNIVERSAL HARDWARE
scenes.text: All Game Boy models shared the same CPU, so games stayed playable across generations.
scenes.query: Game Boy hardware compatibility across models
